acceptanceCriteria.text: Publish completion knows the expected Pages URL for the exact PR/head manifest without guessing from local filesystem state.
A bounded retry/poll verifies HTTP reachability and manifest repository/PR/head identity.
Outcomes distinguish at least push failure, published-but-not-serving, serving-wrong-identity, and success.
Retry duration is bounded and cannot hold the workflow indefinitely.
Verification sends no credentials to the public Pages endpoint and logs no secrets.
Tests cover delayed availability, persistent 404, wrong manifest identity and success through a hermetic HTTP fixture.
Documentation states the required repository Pages configuration and the diagnostic emitted when it is absent/misconfigured.
Existing immutable revision and concurrent multi-PR publication behavior is unchanged.

issue.title: chore: verify Review Pages availability after gh-pages publication
